scope: One bounded Korean realization mechanism experiment, not prolonged generator/evaluator optimization.
formal_name: KRC v0.2 — Proof-Carrying Korean Clause Realization, Source-Atom Locality, Deterministic Discourse Assembly & Pragmatic Construction Licensing

p53_v01_observed_defeater.empirical_antecedent: The monolithic 0.6B LLM often treated instructions as output meta-commentary or titles/lists, even for B and A; typed planner success did not transfer to surface output.
p53_v01_observed_defeater.restriction: Do not re-prompt or re-generate the six v0.1 briefs and call it a clean improvement.

new_computation.step1: Construct typed licensed-fact graph and Korean discourse-state trajectory; explicit information packaging, reference and stance.
new_computation.step2: Compile each rhetorical slot into a local Korean clause obligation (1-2 fact atoms, known speaker/register and a licensed connective relation).
new_computation.step3: Let a surface realizer propose only this clause, returning surface bytes + fact IDs + locality witness. This is NOT a guarantee of semantic entailment.
new_computation.step4: Check identifier/range, forbidden new numeric/person spans and simple verbatim controls. If no licensable clause is available, record typed failure and emit explicitly labeled source-exact fallback, never a quality PASS.
new_computation.step5: Assemble paragraphs deterministically from accepted local clauses and KRC discourse graph; no LLM-authored meta title or summary headings can enter the assembly.
new_computation.step6: Independently examine semantic fidelity and Korean naturalness of the *assembled passage*, not only clauses.

korean_surface_operation_algebra.risk: Topic, contrast and presupposition change; optional, not a free synonym

korean_surface_operation_algebra.output: joining or separation with a valid connective

korean_surface_operation_algebra.risk: Interactional stance or speech act shift

korean_surface_operation_algebra.output: bounded long/short clause distribution; allowed repetition
korean_surface_operation_algebra.risk: Arbitrary noise disguised as human style

korean_surface_operation_algebra.output: Korean conventional collocation and limited register choice
korean_surface_operation_algebra.risk: Semantic strengthening, evaluative or emotional additions

formal_target: A total document composer for finite licensed slot sequences, with an auditable source-to-clause witness. The totality theorem is about assembling validated typed/failed slots with visible fallbacks, not about guaranteeing Korean fluency or semantic equivalence of model proposals.
defeat_conditions: Local clause generation still regularly invents meanings or fails basic idiomatic Korean: stronger linguistic realization model or language-specific grammar is necessary.
Natural readers prefer generic output after controlling semantic fidelity and format: no KRC advantage established.
Only sentence-splitting makes outputs look better while document discourse weakens: architecture not sufficient.
A longer prompt or a labeled source fallback explains any performance differences: need equal-token untyped planning and non-neural controls.

fresh_evaluation.sources: Newly authored, outcome-unseen Korean two-genre briefs; do not treat EX01-EX06 as new confirmatory data.
arms: U same-token-budget untyped local plan for structural attribution
fresh_evaluation.reader: Blind paired preference and separate source factuality review. No LLM-as-judge quality gold.
fresh_evaluation.anti_drift: At most one mechanism step without a direct Korean full-passage linguistic finding.
